primary_contract: public dataset discovery, access/licensing assessment, fail-closed real-data ETL, MIMIC-IV Demo worked example, provenance/data-quality outputs, and Conductor review/push discipline
completion_evidence: GitHub issue links for deferred ED, FHIR/MEDS, dataset registry, and downloader/cache work
GitHub Actions review evidence for the completed track branch or PR

included: Public clinical dataset discovery and access assessment.
MIMIC-IV Demo local-file ETL for admitted-episode staging.
Fail-closed calculator-input preparation when Australian AR-DRG provenance is missing.
Synthetic AR-DRG overlay fixture for runnable documentation only.
Provenance, data-quality, support-status, and CLI/file interop outputs that demonstrate existing advanced tooling.
Issue-backed follow-on feature discovery for examples or infrastructure that should not be bundled into the initial track.
excluded: Bundling raw MIMIC files or patient-level public dataset extracts.
Redistributing restricted clinical classification tables or grouping assets.
Claiming authoritative Australian NWAU calculation from MIMIC alone.
Implementing or reimplementing proprietary AR-DRG grouping logic.

gap_register.description: MIMIC US DRG and diagnosis/procedure fields are not Australian AR-DRG, ICD-10-AM, ACHI, or ACS inputs; authoritative NWAU examples require local AR-DRG provenance or an explicitly synthetic overlay.
Raw public clinical dataset files must remain local-only and must not be committed to the repository.
